These are system-reported diagnostics, not an actual GL context probe or a game benchmark. They cannot confirm frame pacing, temperature, sound playback, or game compatibility. No unsupported graphics/audio toggles are offered; command-line arguments and environment overrides remain advanced options.

These controls simulate keyboard/mouse input: movement = WASD, jump = Space, use = E, reload = R, fire = mouse button 1. They are not an analogue gamepad and may not match every game/mod.
